title: Bugs/625412 Wrong posted G/L Entries and VAT Entries using Cash Basis Unrealized VAT from a partial Credit Memo if we mix VAT types and use only part of the amount in the Mexican version.
summary: Cash-basis VAT calculations for partial credit memo applications now correctly determine settled amounts per VAT posting group, preventing incorrect G/L entries between realized and unrealized VAT accounts.
key_points: Fixed VAT realization to use settled amount per VAT group instead of total settled amount
Added dedicated calculation for credit memo portion associated with each VAT posting group
Currency factor is applied before VAT amount calculation
Added condition to prevent G/L entries when credit memo application does not represent actual VAT realization
Comprehensive test coverage added for cash-basis VAT credit memo scenarios
quote: Cash-basis VAT credit memos now realize VAT correctly for each VAT posting group.
